issue_context.title: Database Tables should list views in selected schema, not list all views.
issue_context.body: # Bug report - [x] I confirm this is a bug with Supabase, not with my own application. - [x] I confirm I have searched the [Docs](https://docs.supabase.com), GitHub [Discussions](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/discussions), and [Discord](https://discord.supabase.com). ## Describe the bug At `Database -> Database Tables`, views other than the selected schema show in the list. This issue only affects the self-host or local devlopement environments, not platform version, as they request different apis. I have tracked this bug. I believe it's caused by not pass `include_schemas` query parameter to `pg-meta` https://github.com/supabase/supabase/blob/f9751c2e13976a9cf5d4227908e009a8868afde5/apps/studio/pages/api/pg-meta/%5Bref%5D/views.ts#L24-L33 To fix this issue, we could reuse the code of `tables list` https://github.com/supabase/supabase/blob/f9751c2e13976a9cf5d4227908e009a8868afde5/apps/studio/pages/api/pg-meta/%5Bref%5D/tables.ts#L29-L55 I guess `foreign table` and `material view` will cause the same issue. I can send a PR to fix this issue if this issue is confirmed by the supabase team. ## To Reproduce Steps to reproduce the behavior, please provide code snippets or a repository: 1. Go to '…' 2. Click on '…' 3. Scroll down to '…' 4. See error ## Expected behavior A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen. ## Screenshots If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem. ## System information - OS: [e.g. macOS, Windows] - Browser (if applies) [e.g. chrome, safari] - Version of supabase-js: [e.g. 6.0.2] - Version of Node.js: [e.g. 10.10.0] ## Additional context Add any other context about the problem here.
comments: Yup I think that's it. A PR would be great @jingsam, thank you!
